neighbours.label: the piece before 'annual'/'-ennial' in per-year frequency words (semi|-annual, bi|-annual, bi|ennial, an|ual): predicts 'annual'
fire: Dividends are paid on a semi-annual basis to all shareholders.
The society holds a bi-annual conference in Vienna.
The award is given biennially to a young researcher.
El informe anual del banco se publicó en marzo.
Members must file a semi-annual report with the board.
The city hosts a biennial art exhibition every other summer.
La cuota anual es de cincuenta euros por persona.
The newsletter switched to a semi-annual schedule last spring.
quiet: Dividends are paid on a quarterly basis to all shareholders.
The society holds a weekly seminar in Vienna.
The award is given every month to a young researcher.
El informe mensual del banco se publicó en marzo.
Members must file a monthly report with the board.
The city hosts a summer art exhibition by the river.
La cuota mensual es de cincuenta euros por persona.
The newsletter switched to a weekly schedule last spring.

notes: logit effect: the - pole promotes ' annual', ' ann', ' annually', ' yearly'; + pole is 'daily / once' (ежедневно, einmal, jeden)
